name: Wild Rice Mushroom Pilaf
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ⅓ cup wild rice blend, rinsed
steps: Dry-sauté the mushrooms for 6 minutes until browned; set aside.
Heat the oil and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add garlic and thyme.
Add the rice and stock, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 40 minutes until tender.
Stir in the mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes.
Sear the tofu separately and fold it in at the end.
Season with pepper and finish with parsley.
note: Wild rice is chewy and takes longer to cook than white or brown rice.
